blurb: Single-output controller in a closed case: one level-shifted LED pigtail on GPIO16, sitting on a power rail GPIO12 switches. USB-C carries both power and the serial link; a capacitive touch button sits on the case. ESP32-D0WD-V3, 4 MB flash.
support_note: The USB bridge enumerates as 1a86:7523, a VID:PID the CH340C and CH340G share, and the case hides the silkscreen — the exact part is unconfirmed, though driver guidance is the same for both.

notes.text: The LED output only has power while GPIO12 is asserted: with the rail off the strip is dark, not dim. GPIO12 is also the MTDI flash-voltage strap, so it is low at boot and driven high afterwards.
LightPlayer registers no driver for the onboard MEMS microphone or the IR receiver, so this board runs neither audio-reactive effects nor IR remotes.
The vendor pinout guide lists a dupont header carrying 3V3, switched 5 V, GND and GPIO21/22/23/25. None of those pins are declared here — they are not verified on the desk unit.
